# TC-CLI-311 配置全链路（FR-15）：config set repo 后，backup/list/info/restore/delete 不带 --repo
# 都使用配置的仓库；--repo 仍优先于配置。

exec databackup --json config set repo $WORK/configured
stdout '"command":"config","repo":"[^"]*/configured"'

exec databackup --json backup --source $WORK/src --name viaconfig
stdout '"path":"[^"]*/configured/viaconfig\.dbk"'
exists $WORK/configured/viaconfig.dbk

exec databackup --json list
stdout '"repo":"[^"]*/configured","backups":\[\{"name":"viaconfig"'

exec databackup --json info viaconfig
stdout '"command":"info","name":"viaconfig"'

exec databackup --json restore --backup viaconfig --target $WORK/out
stdout '"command":"restore",.*"files":1,'
treeeq src out

# --repo 优先于配置
exec databackup --json list --repo $WORK/other
stdout '"repo":"[^"]*/other","backups":\[\]'

exec databackup --json delete viaconfig
! exists $WORK/configured/viaconfig.dbk

-- src/a.txt --
a
